title: from_hex test helper panics on odd-length input with cryptic index-out-of-range
description: smime_tests.rs lines 72-76: from_hex uses step_by(2) over 0..s.len(), which for an odd-length string will attempt to read s[len-1..len+1] at the last iteration, causing a panic with a cryptic 'byte index N is not a char boundary' or slice index panic. A test helper that panics cryptically on malformed input wastes debugging time. Should assert\!(s.len() % 2 == 0, 'hex string must have even length') at entry. Low impact since the hex literals are correct, but a future developer adding a test fixture who accidentally truncates the hex string will waste time.
close_reason: P4 test hygiene: from_hex is private test helper; cryptic panic on odd input is acceptable for internal use.
